data.plainLyric:
久未放晴的天空^The sky that has not cleared up for a long time
依舊留著妳的笑容^Still keep your smile
哭過 卻無法掩埋歉疚^I cried but could not hide my guilt
風箏在陰天擱淺^Kite stranded on cloudy day
想念還在等待救援^Miss you and still waiting for rescue
我拉著線 複習妳給的溫柔^I pull the thread to review the tenderness you gave me
曝曬在一旁的寂寞^Loneliness exposed to the side
笑我給不起承諾^Laugh, I can’t make a promise
怎麼會怎麼會 妳竟原諒了我^How could it happen? You actually forgave me?
我只能永遠讀著對白^I can only read the dialogue forever
讀著我給妳的傷害^Read the hurt I caused you
我原諒不了我^I can't forgive me
就請妳當作我已不在^Just treat me as if I'm no longer here
我睜開雙眼 看著空白^I opened my eyes and looked blank
忘記妳對我的期待^Forget your expectations of me
讀完了依賴 我很快就離開^After reading Dependence, I will leave soon
